policy.fetchByHashMeaning: Candidate may be acquired only by an explicit preparation step using repository commit plus exact path and SHA-256. Preserve full notices and original bytes. A hash is an identity check, not a license grant. No fetch takes place during tests or golden generation.
policy.skipMeaning: Not a runnable or successful case. Inventory-only, unresolved permission, restricted license, empty snapshot, missing directory or uninspected grammar remains visible in its own denominator.
policy.attribution: Directory-specific third-party notices and file-level notices take precedence over repository-default grants. Source-bearing generated results inherit source restrictions.
policy.scope: Selected candidate review is bounded. Other files have complete byte hashes and a full-text marker scan, not a claim of complete licensing clearance.

provenanceCategories.own: A reviewed repository-authored candidate; the record says whether authorship is explicit or inferred.
provenanceCategories.borrowed: A third-party directory notice or file attribution identifies an external origin. License status is recorded separately.
provenanceCategories.no-established-license: No candidate-level provenance/license clearance was established. Root-license context alone is insufficient for selection.

policy.expectationPolicy: Stored upstream expectations are diagnostic to their named profiles. Product goldens must be generated with the pinned product grammar/registration closure by reference adapters. Grammar core equality and nonempty snapshots do not establish parity.
policy.sourceBytes: SHA-256 is computed on exact file bytes. No LF conversion, annotation removal, trimming or BOM stripping was performed.
policy.inventoryHashEncoding: Sort source.fileIds by repository-relative path using JavaScript localeCompare with locale en, then concatenate lowercase SHA-256, two ASCII spaces, path, LF for every inventory entry; SHA-256 that UTF-8 text.

storageCheck.caveat: VDO logical free space is not physical Samsung SSD capacity. Only three shallow clones and small pinned raw files were downloaded; no large install occurred.

coreComparisonContract.encoding: UTF-8 JSON.stringify of recursively lexicographically key-sorted objects; arrays preserve order; no final newline.
coreComparisonContract.meaning: Equal hashes establish only equality of the selected grammar core fields. No oracle was executed.

openQuestions.question: Which historic grammar/build revisions generated committed upstream baselines?
openQuestions.recommendation: Keep generation revisions null. Use pinned current grammar bytes for named diagnostic profiles and regenerate product goldens in the reference adapter lane. Do not infer a generation commit from checkout HEAD.

openQuestions.question: Can externally attributed catalog/VS Code/TypeScript examples be redistributed?
openQuestions.recommendation: Keep them skipped until their original file/revision and applicable permission notice are pinned. Prefer small independently authored substitutes for pilot TSX, JSX, JSON and Markdown mixed cases.

openQuestions.question: Does matching a primary grammar core establish injection parity?
openQuestions.recommendation: No. Use the product-profile registration/dependency closure; core hashes deliberately exclude aliases and embedded/injection metadata.

openQuestions.question: Can empty VS Code Tree-sitter snapshots count as supported passes?
openQuestions.recommendation: No. Record 91 empty captures separately and require an explicit complete reference result before scoring.

openQuestions.question: Should shared reference clones be updated?
openQuestions.recommendation: This task pins their observed read-only heads. A separately authorized update must produce new revision/file hashes and a named profile change.
